repos/ltn-it/.github/pulls/987.title: fix(control): close Supplementary funding and scheduling boundaries
repos/ltn-it/.github/pulls/987.body:
Supplementary can reach the same review candidate through historical Legacy runs, multiple PRs, native verifier refreshes and an explicitly approved Recovery. This change retains consumed allocations across PR/base/input changes, verifies a fresh canonical qualification from native repository evidence, and preserves the existing exact one-extra-attempt Recovery contract.

The scheduling boundary retains GitHub's native queue instead of replacing pending invocations with no jobs. Source-owned deferral reaches finalization before existing Copilot evidence can write acceptance. Recovery rechecks the latest native generation immediately before its receipt/return. Jobless canceled and otherwise unknown histories continue to deny funding. Other repositories retain their current cancellation behavior. The canonical queue validator admits one exact Source/Supplementary profile; every other actionlint check remains required.

The completed correction after review 5708527220 is the bounded work item **bounded abort receipt encoding + least-read Recovery preflight**. Only common-quality receives checks:read, so the actual private-repository Recovery preflight can read native check history. Complete generation inventory and every full native record reread remain mandatory. Receipt encoding then retains the current generation and one deterministic newest-generation witness. Version 2 receipts carry only number/base/head as their subject and bind the complete unchanged, separately stored operation with operation_sha256. Strict version 1 compatibility remains. This avoids copying large native metadata and PR bodies into the bounded receipt, without increasing limits, truncating operations, forgiving unknown history or granting another allocation.

Validation on a7f826492c5ae5757512e5ddfb4523b298068121: all 837 unit tests pass in the digest-pinned Devtools image, as do repository quality, instruction/target validation, the exact queue validator, all workflow actionlint checks, ShellCheck, Git diff checks and deterministic patch/secret review. Real regression paths demonstrate the previous native-check 403 and oversized receipt failures, then exercise actual Recovery/reservation/emit/verify successfully, including near-limit Unicode operations, 100 large native follower records and negative tampering/drift cases. The executable profile bootstrap has no invented local Push-Ready attestation; protected native CI and current-head review remain mandatory.

Reviews 5707493167, 5708014246 and 5708527220 remain consumed. The documented structural simplification and independently checked 19,501-byte four-file correction permit exactly one specifically bound completion review of this head in this PR, after native code CI passes. A further finding, missing verdict or unknown request stops automatic allocation. No counter, prior finding or provider outcome is reset.

This PR does not activate a repository rule, select its own Source, or authorize a release. The actual Supplementary Required Workflow mutex, real v1-to-v2 protected-branch transition, Management producer/retirement integration and existing product-ingress promotion are separate operational acceptance steps.
